m14.text: The merfolk raiders, a small group living on a reef offshore, ransack Zurbit's tower in Magic 2014, prying open a window and making off with the lot.
Zurbit rows to the merfolk reef with his cat Pip and drops a message in a flask, and a merfolk surfaces and hisses at him with contempt before submerging.
Zurbit then gives Pip a green potion and pushes him out over the reef as the cat grows to the size of a small whale.
